unit: Lisansüstü Eğitim Enstitüsü (LEE) – yüksek lisans ve doktora final tezi
note: Common LEE final-thesis rules extracted from the official 2025 guide and four 2026 defense checklists. DOCX paragraphs/tables have no stable printed-page pagination in this inspection; locators use python-docx paragraph indices (P[n]) and WordprocessingML table/row/paragraph paths. Guide table indices are zero-based in the extracted inventory; OOXML tbl/tr/p indices below are one-based. Diagram labels in w:txbxContent are explicitly included. Proposal-writing guide is a separate target and is not extracted here. Template-specific cover and approval XML/measurements are owned by the companion analysis.

conflicts.topic: 2026 YL post-defense checklist uses generic YL-or-doctorate wording

sources.value: Kapak ve iç kapak sayfalarında YÜKSEK LİSANS ve ya DOKTORA şeklinde elde edilen unvan yazıldı.
Guide applies to master and doctoral theses, with distinct degree labels and specific 3-member/5-member jury sizes.

conflicts.decision: The YL checklist text is generic and its file/document title is YL; it is not evidence that a master's thesis should say Doktora. Preserve as checklist wording; follow degree-specific content from guide and official template. No formatting-value conflict established.

unknowns.why: Only English ABSTRACT requirements are established; no English-language full-thesis variant is present in the supplied LEE sources.
Guide states same font character as body and bottom-right position, but does not establish page-number point size or exact footer distance in guide prose.
Guide specifies 1.25 cm heading indent and aligned page numbers, but not dot leaders, tab stops, or exact indent depth per subheading level.
Abstract prose rules are explicit, but exact line positions/spacing beyond stated one-line spacing and 6 nk paragraph spacing depend on template example XML and are reserved for companion inspection.
Guide specifies table content numeric/text alignment in some contexts and overall table centered placement, but does not establish a universal cell alignment rule.
The post-defense checklists specify footnotes as 10 pt Times New Roman, but the guide/checklists do not establish line spacing, separator, or numbering behavior.
The guide says quotations beyond reasonable limits are an ethical violation, but states no numeric quotation-length/page limit.
